title: DerivedComplianceCellPlacementContract
description: REGCELL-002 contract for deriving compliance-cell placement labels and decision evidence from existing tenant, compliance-pack, regulatory-pack, workload, and audit inputs without creating a parallel source-of-truth cell taxonomy.

governance_registration.required_update_policy: Any change to derived placement inputs, label semantics, decision evidence, or claim boundaries MUST update this contract, its root-hub pointer, and its artifact-capabilities registry row in the same PR.

_meta.purpose: Lock the contract for computing standard, regulated, CDE, identity-assurance, sovereign, and airgap placement labels over existing source fields: tenant home/dr cells, jurisdiction/residency, data class, compliance packs, pack cell eligibility, workload labels, regulatory pack binding, and audit decision.

can_claim_now: There is a machine-readable contract for deriving placement labels from existing tenant, pack, workload, regulatory-pack, and audit-decision inputs.
The contract refuses any user-authored or independently persisted placement taxonomy as source of truth.
The contract states required evidence fields for future placement decisions and validation gates.
cannot_claim_yet: a live placement scheduler or reconciler exists
any cell is certified for a named pack
regulatory pack binding is enforced at runtime
eligible cell pools are provisioned or observable
tenant workloads can be migrated automatically
branch protection or presubmit enforces this contract

source_of_truth_rule.rule: Placement labels are derived views. They MUST NOT be accepted as independent operator input, committed as a separate canonical cell taxonomy, or used without source input references and an audit decision.

rules.label: standard
rules.meaning: Lean default placement in tenant home/dr cells after residency and audit gates pass.
required_when_all: No active compliance pack or workload/data-class trigger requires elevated certification, provider restrictions, stricter DR floors, attested freshness, or special audit handling.
The selected home_cell and dr_cell satisfy tenant jurisdiction.data_residency_allowed and the audit decision is allow.

rules.label: regulated
rules.meaning: At least one pack, data class, workload label, DR floor, BYOK requirement, freshness mode, or audit decision narrows placement beyond standard cells.
required_when_any: tenant.compliance_packs is non-empty and the active pack contributes any cell eligibility, retention, consent, cross-tenant, audit-chain, DR-floor, BYOK, or jurisdiction-overlay requirement
workload.data_classes intersects a compliance-pack data_class_extensions set or a known regulated class family
workload.labels includes regulated, phi, public-sector, high-risk-ai, finance-control, legal-hold, regulator-evidence, or equivalent policy label
audit_decision.state is block_missing_evidence, requires_subscope, requires_migration, or requires_human_review for a compliance reason

rules.label: cde
rules.meaning: Cardholder-data environment placement for PCI/card payment data and workflows.
required_when_any: workload.data_classes contains PAYMENT_PAN, PAYMENT_TRACK_DATA, PAYMENT_CVV, CARDHOLDER_DATA, or an equivalent pack-defined CDE class
tenant.compliance_packs or regulatory_pack_binding.primary_pack_id names a PCI-DSS pack
workload.labels contains cde, pci, cardholder-data, pan, cvv, payment-auth, or tokenization-boundary
required_control_vector_additions: CDE-only key material or HSM/KMS partition evidence when required

rules.label: identity-assurance
rules.meaning: High-assurance identity, KYC/KYB, proofing, passkey ceremony, workload-signing, or personnel-control placement.
required_when_any: tenant.kyc_status is pending_documents, in_review, verified_enhanced, expired, suspended, or rejected and the workload reads/writes KYC/KYB artifacts
workload.labels contains identity-proofing, kyc, kyb, sanctions, pep, source-of-funds, passkey-ceremony, jwks-rotation, workload-signing, hsm, fips, personnel-residency, or high-assurance-auth
compliance pack controls require identity-proofing evidence, network_only policy evaluation, attested fallback, HSM/FIPS posture, or personnel constraints
required_control_vector_additions: policy freshness derived from tenant.policy_evaluation_mode and attested_fallback_threshold
ontology freshness derived from tenant.ontology_read_mode and freshness_floor
key ceremony and audit-chain evidence when the action mutates identity authority

rules.label: sovereign
rules.meaning: Placement constrained by jurisdiction, residency, sovereign-cloud pack, regional provider set, or regulatory pack residency class.
required_when_any: tenant.jurisdiction.data_residency_allowed excludes otherwise eligible regions for home/dr cells
compliance_pack.jurisdiction_overlay narrows eligible regions or provider residency
workload.labels contains sovereign, residency-bound, public-sector, government, kr-csap, eu-sovereign, fedramp, irap, mtcs, or regulator-residency
required_control_vector_additions: candidate home_cell and dr_cell region/provider must be inside allowed residency set
provider contract, BAA/DPA/SCC, or regulator evidence reference when required by the pack

rules.label: airgap
rules.meaning: No-external-egress / in-cell substitution placement for air-gapped sovereign or regulator-bound packs.
required_when_any: sovereign-cloud-air-gapped-canonical per-pack matrix marks the applicable pack air_gap true
workload.labels contains airgap, no-egress, offline-evidence, in-cell-registry, in-cell-kms, in-cell-llm, or regulator-offline-media
audit_decision.reason_codes contains external-egress-denied, in-cell-dependency-required, or airgap-required
required_control_vector_additions: external API egress denied by default
in-cell registry, secret store, audit shard, observability backend, and provider/model substitutes are declared
no fallback to standard cells or external SaaS providers when airgap is active

derivation_algorithm.rule: Load tenant, active compliance packs, pack floors, regulatory pack binding, workload envelope, and current audit decision. Missing required source refs produce block_missing_evidence rather than an inferred label.
Normalize workload.data_classes and workload.labels to lowercase comparison keys while preserving original values in evidence.
Apply placement_label_contract rules. standard is emitted only when no stricter label is present; regulated is emitted with any stricter compliance label.

Union baseline tenant controls, jurisdiction overlays, pack cell_eligibility, forbidden_cells, BYOK requirements, DR floors, policy/ontology freshness, and audit-decision requirements. Resolve conflicts by stricter-rule-wins and deny-wins.

Start with tenant home_cell/dr_cell and any candidate pool supplied by the future cell registry; filter by residency, provider, pack certification, forbidden_cells, DR pair, freshness, health, and airgap controls. This contract does not define the future cell registry itself.

Persist or emit only a decision record with source refs/hashes, derived labels, control vector, eligible pool hash, selected home/dr cells if any, blockers, and audit decision. The derived labels alone are never source of truth.

future_gate_semantics.intent: Fail if a decision record has labels without tenant, pack, regulatory-pack, workload, and audit source refs.
Fail if candidate artifacts introduce an independent standard/regulated/CDE/identity-assurance/sovereign/airgap cell registry instead of deriving labels from source fields.
Fail if cost/capacity scoring runs before residency, certification, forbidden_cells, DR floor, freshness, and airgap hard denies.
Fail if placement allows or blocks without a typed audit decision and reason codes.

non_goals: No product/runtime implementation of placement scheduling or migration.
No mutation of tenant-model or compliance-pack schema semantics in this slice.
No new API endpoint or CLI command.
No new generated JSON face and no hand-edited generated artifact.
No certification/readiness claim for any cell, provider, pack, or tenant.
